name: Homemade Belgian Fries
description: Frieten the Belgian way: fried twice for a fluffy inside and crisp outside.
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut into 1 cm sticks. Rinse and dry thoroughly.
Pre-fry in batches at 150 °C for 6 minutes until soft but pale. Drain and cool at least 15 minutes.
Fry again at 180 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and crisp. Salt and serve with mayonnaise.

name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
description: Smooth potato purée with butter, milk and nutmeg.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, 20 minutes.
Drain and dry briefly over the heat.
Mash with warm milk and butter until smooth. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.

name: Gratin Dauphinois
description: Thinly sliced potatoes baked slowly in garlicky cream.
steps: Heat the cream and milk with garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Layer the potatoes in a buttered dish and pour over the cream.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 160 °C for 75 minutes until tender and golden.

name: Coleslaw
description: Crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw with a light yoghurt-mayonnaise dressing.
steps: Mix mayonnaise, yoghurt, vinegar and mustard and season.
Toss with the cabbage, carrot and onion. Rest 15 minutes before serving.

name: Green Salad with Vinaigrette
description: Simple lettuce, lamb's lettuce and cucumber salad with a mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Whisk mustard, vinegar, shallot, salt and pepper, then whisk in the oil.
Toss with the leaves and cucumber just before serving.

name: Hummus with Vegetable Sticks
description: Smooth homemade hummus with carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks.
steps: Blend the chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, 3 tbsp oil and 4 tbsp ice-cold water until very smooth. Season.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with the remaining oil and dust with paprika.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

name: Guacamole with Tortilla Chips
description: Chunky guacamole with lime, tomato, red onion and coriander.
steps: Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt, leaving some texture.
Fold in tomato, onion, chilli and coriander.
Serve straight away with tortilla chips.

name: Banana Bread
description: Moist loaf made with very ripe bananas and walnuts. Keeps for days.
steps: Mash the bananas and whisk in melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and walnuts.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175 °C for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool before slicing.

name: Chocolate Mousse
description: Airy dark chocolate mousse, the Belgian bistro dessert.
steps: Melt the chocolate with the butter and let it cool slightly. Stir in the egg yolks one by one.
Whisk the egg whites with salt to soft peaks, then add the sugar and whisk until glossy.
Fold the whites into the chocolate in three parts. Chill for at least 4 hours.

name: Apple Crumble
description: Warm cinnamon apples under a buttery oat crumble.
steps: Toss the apples with cinnamon, 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon in an oven dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, oats and sugar until crumbly and scatter over the fruit.
Bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes. Serve warm with yoghurt.

name: Speculoos Tiramisu
description: Belgian twist on tiramisu with speculoos biscuits soaked in coffee.
ingredients: 20 g ground coffee, brewed with 250 ml water and cooled
steps: Beat egg yolks with sugar until pale, then beat in the cream cheese.
Whip the cream and egg whites separately and fold both into the cheese mixture.
Dip the biscuits briefly in coffee and layer with the cream in a dish, twice.
Chill overnight and dust with cocoa before serving.
